message.Title: Retirement: Azure VMware Solution AV36 Node Retirement now on August 30, 2027

Body.Content:
UPDATED: Microsoft announced the retirement of the AV36 node type on June 30, 2028, that date has changed to align with VMware’s roadmap. Broadcom will end support for the current AV36 version with vSphere 8 on September 30, 2027, and the AV36 SKU is not compatible with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) 9, the next-generation platform. 

As part of this transition, and now to align with the AVS License-include service retirement on August 30, 2027, all AV36 SDDCs will be retired after August 30, 2027, regardless of individual RI expiration dates. On August 31, 2027, these SDDCs will no longer be accessible. 

Key dates for AV36 subscriptions: 

  • June 30, 2026 Last day to buy a 1-year RI for AV36 VCF BYOL  

  • August 30, 2027 AV36 SKU retirement and AVS License -included service retirement. 

  • August 31, 2027 SDDC access will be removed. 

Contact your Microsoft Account Team for key dates for AV36 PayGo subscriptions.

Recommended action 

At this time, we recommend that you review your current AV36 SDDCs and then work with your Microsoft Account Team. Identify available AVS node types on the Azure Product by Region page, and visit the AVS Documentation page to learn about HCX migrations between AVS node types.

Help and support 

If you have questions, please reach out to your Microsoft Account Team.
